title: Face lit at the trailhead gate

tokens.v: He plants his wrist on the trailhead gate rail and turns the watch square to the lens, forearm level so the display faces camera dead-on and is LIT: an abstract non-textual glow, a soft teal-into-white radial bloom with one thin arc of colour, no numerals, no icons, no readable interface, spilling onto the rounded-square titanium case and the woven stone-grey nylon strap. 105mm at f/2.8 at chest height a stride away, lens axis perpendicular to the sapphire glass so the case reads with no keystoning, the watch about a fifth of the frame; the polished steel crown stands proud on the near flank taking one cold specular, MERIDIAN laser-etched crisp and legible along that flank. Cold fog, breath showing, his other hand gripping the gate post out of focus in the near-left and cut by the edge, pines dissolving into mist behind, a trail marker's red blaze floating soft. Full running kit, fully dressed: charcoal shell, black tights, grey trail shoes.
